# GradeMyBuilding

> Professional building inspection and grading platform. Inspectors, agents, appraisers, assessors, underwriters, and owners use it to grade buildings A+ to F with photos, reports, and shareable results.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What GradeMyBuilding does and who it serves.
- [Search Building Grades](/search): Look up inspection grades for buildings by address, city, state, or property type.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription tiers from Free/Starter to Enterprise.
- [Contact](/contact): Get answers from the AI Inspector Assistant or message the team.
- [Sign In / Sign Up](/auth): Create an account or sign in.
